info.name: PRISM Register API
info.description:
PRISM platform walkthrough built around ONE dummy company — EcoSoch Solar Pvt Ltd (code ECOSOCH), a Karnataka C&I rooftop-solar EPC — which carries a lead, a deal with ALL THREE product lines (lending 25 Cr + syndication 40 Cr + asset monetisation 60 Cr), a lender on the mandate, versioned financials, a PPA, documents, interactions, monitoring, and external intel.

PORTS (single docker-compose):
- Gateway (REST-API service, RBAC gate) — http://localhost:8001 — {{baseUrl}} — ALL business calls go here
- Access (users/roles/matrix) — http://localhost:8002 — {{accessUrl}} — governance, Admin-only writes
- Register (data plane) — http://localhost:8000 — {{registerUrl}} — admin plane (tenants, import) & machine callers
- NGINX edge — http://localhost:8080 — same paths as the gateway
- VocX — http://localhost:8003 · MinIO console — :9001 · Temporal UI — :8088

HOW TO RUN: import the 'PRISM — Local' environment, then run folders 00 → 21 in order — create requests auto-save ids ({{entityId}}, {{dealId}}, …) into the environment, so every later request already points at the ECOSOCH records. Identity: every request carries X-User-Email {{userEmail}} (default admin@evamfinance.com, seeded with Admin+Management) — change it to e.g. chetan@evamfinance.com (created in folder 01) to see RBAC denials and SCOPED behaviour. Machine mode: drop X-User-Email and call {{registerUrl}} with just the X-API-Key.

item.name: 00 · Health & Meta
item.description: Liveness of all three services and the gateway's composed identity endpoint. Ports: gateway 8001 (all business calls), access 8002 (governance), register 8000 (direct/admin), NGINX edge 8080 (same paths as the gateway).

item.name: Who am I (composed: roles + matrices + assignments)

request.description: Gateway composition: identity facts from the Access service + active line assignments from the Register, in one response.
Force the gateway to refetch /v1/resolve facts (normally TTL + matrix-version driven; useful right after editing users/roles/matrix).

item.name: 16 · Assignments, Requests & Authz (RBAC on the line)
item.description: The scoped half of RBAC, enforced next to the data. Assign the Deal Analyst to the ECOSOCH lending line, then exercise request -> approve. Authority rules: Credit Head assigns Deal Analysts; Syn Head assigns Syn RMs; AM Head assigns AM RMs; Admin/Management override (the default {{userEmail}} admin works).
